profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at AWS
profile.summary: Working as a Full Stack Developer at AWS! Nickname is 🐼 cause Pandas are awesome!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Tech lead, Content Platform — the system of record and retrieval layer for the entire AWS documentation corpus (300k+ pages), rebuilt for agent consumption.

• Built the agentic retrieval stack: a two-layer knowledge graph (deterministic structure + LLM-extracted entities) and hybrid page/chunk search, served through a query router.

• Built an evaluation framework that runs quality checks and governance across the entire corpus, ensuring only validated high-quality content ships.

• Designed a self-improving agent loop with role-scoped long- and short-term memory, checkpointing, and resource hygiene for long-running agent processes.

• Exposed platform capability through unified APIs and MCP tools, vending one consistent interface across UI, data lake, and agent consumers.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Architected and led feature development that enables writers to both author and review all new and existing API documentation in AWS. Decreased review cycle time by 65%, increased auditability, and managed user workflows.
- Integrated AI-assisted authoring into the writer's authoring tool (mentioned above) to decrease documentation time by 50-90%.
- Implemented automated testing suite to support new ONTAP images in AWS FSx decreasing breaking changes by 12%.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer 2
positions.description:
- Working on the Halp product: https://www.atlassian.com/software/halp
- Customized CSV Exports
- Led Private Replies initiative to enable private tickets through all our integrations. Learn more here: https://plz.halp.com/article/gb7whqfn5y-private-requester-thread-replies-setting
- Co-led Queue Admins initiative to enable more admins at a more granular level to lessen the burden on the main admin.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apollo GraphQL · MongoDB · React.js · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Migrated the existing data pipeline to a Serverless Architecture on AWS. Pipeline sent information to Dealer CRMs, OEMs, DealerTrack, VinSolutions, etc.
- Created a cross-product integrations between VinSolutions(Offline) and Accelerate(Online) to ensure our offline and online car buying experiences are seamlessly integrated for shoppers.
- Enabled dealers to transition to an online experience where they can work together with their shopper by allowing them to Share their Deal on the Accelerate platform and integrating with our chat/screen share platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed a real time data pipeline that replicates data into the Google Cloud Platform and then transforms the data to serve out to consumers. Pipeline typically replicates 30,000 transactions/sec and can be scaled up to handle more. 
•	Created APIs using Java and Spring Boot which are deployed in Containers to Compute Engine instances in GCP. Stress tested and easily handled 10,000 calls/sec over an 8 hour duration on a single instance of the application.
•	Built and maintains entire CI/CD Pipeline for 3 teams which has decreased bug creations for new features by 50%, increased testing coverage by 10%, and lowered deployment time by 25%.
•	Supports and releases new features on STEP; the application through where every item available in the Home Depot goes through in order to be sold in the Home Depot in Store or Online.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Java · Spring Boot · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern EC2
positions.description:
•	Implemented a new multi-threaded DPDK stress-testing application that could send 2.1 million packets per second. The application contained 12 Unit Tests to test all portions of the code.
•	Involved in the entire Agile development cycle for the program from requirement specification to deployment. The application underwent 120+ incremental code reviews.
